name: nextjs-vercel-postgres
title: Next.js (App Router) + Postgres + Vercel
summary: TypeScript web app: Next.js App Router, Postgres with copy-on-write branching (Neon) and Drizzle SQL migrations, a vetted auth library, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, Vercel Fluid Compute deploys, GitHub Actions CI, Playwright e2e.
recommended_for: a new full-stack web app where one-push deploys, staging on demand, and a paved AI road matter more than infrastructure control
not_for: CLI tools, data pipelines, mobile apps, or teams already committed to another framework

commands.format: pnpm exec biome format --write . || pnpm exec prettier --write .
commands.deploy: git push origin main (CI-gated Vercel deploy; see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: auto (biome or prettier, detected by post-edit-format.sh)
migration_tool: drizzle-kit (SQL files + journal; watermark = journal timestamp)
app_verifier_boot: pnpm dev (Next dev server on :3000), then drive the changed routes with Playwright or curl

overlay.qa_pack: qa/ (Playwright page sweep, nightly workflow, stage scripts, sandbox seed checklist, dashboard)
